_comment: Tax constants for the tax year given in 'year'. Edit this one file on GitHub each April; the app loads it on next open and warns when it's out of date. DA/DIV = dividend allowance and rates; PSA = personal savings allowance (basic/higher/additional); SRS = starting rate for savings; CT_* = corporation tax; ERNI/ST = employer NI and its threshold; PT/UEL/EENI = employee NI.
